commits.message:
fix(renderables): a region's setter shapes it — Panel and Padding too

Escalation review of #162. A Panel handing its content an exact region is
that region's setter, so it now shapes what comes back: its frame stretches
down a pane and a tall body is cropped above the bottom border. The shaping
and the row parse are one pair of helpers in protocol.ts (fitHeight,
regionRows) shared by Layout, Panel and Padding; insetHeight and
stackedHeight parse rows through cellCount. Markdown stacks its blocks.
rich-dash's ClipHeight is deleted as redundant and InjectMaxHeight shapes
the region it sets.

fix(renderables): containers forward height by the contract

Review of #162: once Layout shapes its panes, a Panel forwarding its region
unchanged let a nested Layout fill it and the crop took the panel's bottom
border. Panel and Padding now inset the budget by their own rows
(insetHeight); Group, Columns and Tree hand each child the rows as a ceiling
(stackedHeight). rich-dash's ClipHeight reserve, which compensated by hand,
is gone.

fix(layout): fill only a region; natural height otherwise, and both splits shape

Review of #162: padding to the 24-row fallback made console.print(layout)
always 24 rows. A layout now fills only an exact region; under a ceiling or
no budget each pane takes its declared size or its content's height, which
deletes the fallback. Rows parse through cellCount (NaN/negative hold none,
Infinity is natural), row splits shape their panes too, and shaping fits the
line count only.

refactor(protocol)!: one Height budget replaces height and maxHeight (rich-viewport-owi.1)

RenderOptions carried a vertical budget as two independent optional numbers,
which admitted a region taller than its ceiling and a region with no ceiling,
and the one reader (Layout) resolved them ceiling-first. It is now one field,
`height?: Height` — `{ rows, exact }` — whose doc comment is the contract:
a region (`exact`) is shaped to exactly `rows` by whoever set it, a ceiling
is cropped by whoever imposed it, containers forward less their own rows,
stackers demote a region to a ceiling, and there is no vertical Measurable.

Layout's column split now keeps that promise: each pane is shaped to its
share, so a short pane no longer pulls the panes below it up.

The design document the ticket named is not written: CLAUDE.md forbids a
second description outside docs/, and rich-export-9a1.1 set the precedent
of contract-as-code plus decisions in the sibling tickets (.2, .3, .5).

BREAKING CHANGE: RenderOptions.height is a Height object and maxHeight is
gone. `{ height: n, maxHeight: n }` becomes `{ height: { rows: n, exact: true } }`.

refactor(render)!: the serializer takes where it writes as one Destination (#161)

* refactor(render)!: the serializer takes where it writes as one Destination

segmentsToString(segments, destination) and segmentToString(segment,
destination) replace the positional colorSystem + hyperlinks pair, so a call
reads segmentsToString(segs, resolveDestination("auto")) or
{ colorSystem: ColorDepth.TRUECOLOR, hyperlinks: true } instead of a bare
`true`, and a depth can no longer be paired with a link setting taken from a
different destination.

Console, Live, Screen and renderToString hand their destination through
whole. renderToString applies its overrides (noColor, hyperlinks) once, where
it builds the value; Console applies its hyperlinks override once, in its
constructor. Console.destination replaces Console.hyperlinks, so Live reads
the value its console encodes for rather than two of its fields.

BREAKING CHANGE: segmentsToString and segmentToString take a Destination
in place of (colorSystem, hyperlinks). Console.hyperlinks is removed; read
console.destination.hyperlinks.

* refactor(style)!: styled text reaches the wire only through segmentsToString

Style.render(text, colorSystem?) was a second ANSI encoder beside
segmentsToString: it could not express a null colour depth, always emitted
OSC 8 links whatever the destination took, and nested SGR inside the link
where the serializer nests the link inside SGR. Nothing in src/ called it.
segmentToString(new Segment(text, style), destination) is the one encoder,
and the style byte tests now go through it with the same assertions.

BREAKING CHANGE: Style.render is removed; use
segmentToString(new Segment(text, style), destination).

* fix(render): the set-once destination is readonly, SGR codes need a depth, Live follows an explicit hyperlinks: false

- Console._destination is readonly: set once, now public through `destination`.
- Style.toSgrCodes takes a required depth; the optional form existed for the
  removed Style.render, and omitting it silently skipped the downgrade.
- osc8.ts: the bytes are a function of the destination, not the depth alone.
- A Live on a console with hyperlinks: false writes no OSC 8 on a terminal.
